description: We are Red Horizon! We are an enthusiastic team of curious, innovative 6th-grade students with a deep passion for science, technology, and space exploration.
summary:
Our project is called Mars Explorers. It is an educational game about Mars. Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and has two moons, Phobos and Deimos. It has interesting places such as Olympus Mons, the largest volcano in the Solar System, and Valles Marineris, a huge canyon.
In our game, players can choose between two characters, Josh and Scarlett. They travel to Mars in a spaceship and explore the planet. Players can move their astronauts using arrows, discover information about rocks and stones, and learn interesting facts about Mars. There are also mini-quizzes and funny aliens in the game.Our main goal is to make learning about Mars fun and interesting. Red Horizon is not a survival game; it is an exploration and educational game.
details:
Our project makes learning fun and accessible. It improves scientific knowledge, curiosity and problem-solving skills. Our main goal is to encourage people, especially young learners, to become more interested in space exploration.
The creative part of our game is combining space exploration, storytelling, interactive characters and quizzes. Our team focused on making the game educational, enjoyable and easy to use.
We used Google Colab to develop our project.
